claims.text: Coral Bay Olefins operates the Sungai Liang cracker in Brunei, which uses ethane feedstock and is currently operating.
The nameplate capacity of the Sungai Liang cracker operated by Coral Bay Olefins is not publicly confirmed in the plant register.
Coral Bay Olefins stated in a company press release that it does not disclose the nameplate capacity for the Sungai Liang cracker.

citations.quote: The company said it does not disclose nameplate capacity for the cracker.

coverage_note: Both the plant register and company press release confirm that the capacity of the Sungai Liang cracker is not publicly disclosed. No public estimate or figure is available in the evidence.
